metadata.title: Gallery | Sanskriti Kindergarten
metadata.description: Explore photos and videos from Sanskriti Kindergarten, including classroom moments, play-based learning, celebrations, and joyful early childhood experiences.

hero.subtitle: A warm look at the learning, play, celebrations, friendships, and everyday confidence growing inside Sanskriti Kindergarten.

image.alt: A warm kindergarten gallery wall with photos of children learning and playing

media.description: Switch between images and videos to explore the spaces, activities, and child-centered experiences that shape our school day.

images.alt: Children clapping together with teachers during an outdoor school gathering
images.title: Morning Gathering
images.description: Children join teachers in a lively courtyard moment filled with rhythm, attention, and group participation.

images.alt: Children seated outdoors while a teacher speaks into a microphone
images.title: Outdoor Story Circle
images.description: A shaded garden session where children sit together, listen, and take part in a shared school experience.

images.alt: Children in traditional dress performing together in the school courtyard
images.title: Cultural Dance
images.description: Children wear traditional attire and build confidence through music, movement, and stage practice.

images.alt: Children dressed as national leaders during an Independence Day activity
images.title: Independence Day Role Play
images.description: Children explore national pride through costumes, flags, and simple role-play guided by teachers.

images.alt: Children and families near a small activity stall with toys and festive props
images.title: Festival Activity Stall
images.description: A hands-on festival corner where children interact with props, toys, and familiar real-world experiences.

images.alt: Children seated near a decorated traditional hut and harvest festival display
images.title: Traditional Festival Setup
images.description: Children gather around a festive harvest display, connecting classroom learning with cultural traditions.

images.alt: Children in traditional dress walking through the courtyard during a festival program
images.title: Festive Courtyard Gathering
images.description: A colorful school celebration where children move through the courtyard in traditional dress.

images.alt: Teacher helping a toddler explore colorful xylophones and percussion toys
images.title: Music Exploration
images.description: A close learning moment with sound, color, and guided sensory exploration.

images.alt: Children performing with pom-poms on an outdoor stage
images.title: Stage Performance
images.description: Young performers practice coordination and confidence during a bright outdoor dance program.

images.alt: Children taking part in a sports day race with adults guiding them
images.title: Sports Day Race
images.description: Children participate in a track activity with encouragement from teachers and families.

images.alt: Children lined up on a sports field track for an activity
images.title: Track Line-Up
images.description: A structured outdoor activity that helps children practice listening, waiting, and movement.

images.alt: Child arranging bright colored blocks during an outdoor sports activity
images.title: Block Balance Activity
images.description: A playful gross-motor task using colorful blocks, focus, and simple problem solving.

images.alt: Child receiving a medal after a sports day event
images.title: Medal Moment
images.description: A proud recognition moment after children complete their sports day activities.

images.alt: Children standing on a winners podium with medals after sports day
images.title: Winners Podium
images.description: Children celebrate participation and achievement with medals on the sports day podium.

images.alt: Children receiving medals from a guest during the sports day prize distribution
images.title: Prize Distribution
images.description: A warm closing moment where children receive medals and encouragement from the school community.

cta.title: Come see the warmth in person.
cta.description: Photos show the moments. A visit helps you feel the rhythm, care, and calm of the school day.
